note: Reviewed Liquipedia team name -> FACEIT org/team. Keys are the folded Liquipedia name, or 'name|na' / 'name|emea' when the same name is two teams in two regions; entity_type is 'org' (entity_id is the org slug) or 'team' (an unmapped FACEIT team id). The reconciler trusts these and only these without marking a link provisional. Edit by hand or with `python -m owcsmuse liquipedia teams decide`. An entry may carry valid_from/valid_to, or `eras` (a list of {entity_type, entity_id, valid_from, valid_to}) when different team ids carried the name over time; a name resolves at the series' own time and is undecided outside every era.

Supersedes the Stage 1 decision (team 2b7f8ef6 for all time), whose 5 conflicting votes for a35f8d47 were the 2026 era.
